Route32CooltrainerMText_AideIsWaiting:
{PLAYER}, right?
Some guy wearing

glasses was look-
ing for you.

See for yourself.
He's waiting for

you at the #MON
CENTER.
Route32CooltrainerMText_UnusedSproutTowe:
Have you gone to
SPROUT TOWER?

If you ever visit
VIOLET CITY, 

they'll expect you
to train there.

That's basic for
trainers. Go to SPROUT TOWER!
Route32CooltrainerMText_VioletGym:
Have you gone to
the #MON GYM?

You can test your
#MON and your- self there.

It's a rite of
passage for all trainers!
Route32CooltrainerMText_HaveThisSeed:
You have some good
#MON there.

It must be from
the training you

gave them around
VIOLET CITY.

The training at
the GYM must have

been especially
helpful.

As a souvenir of
VIOLET CITY, take this.

It increases the
power of grass- type moves.
Route32CooltrainerMText_ExperiencesShoul:
Your experiences
in VIOLET CITY

should be useful
for your journey.
Text_MillionDollarSlowpokeTail:
How would you like
to have this

tasty, nutritious
SLOWPOKETAIL?

For you right now,
just ¥1,000,000!

You'll want this!
Text_ThoughtKidsWereLoaded:
Tch! I thought
kids these days were loaded…
Text_RefusedToBuySlowpokeTail:
You don't want it?
Then scram. Shoo!
FisherJustinSeenText:
Whoa!

You made me lose
that fish!
FisherJustinAfterText:
Calm, collected…
The essence of

fishing and #-
MON is the same.
FisherRalph1SeenText:
I'm really good at
both fishing and #MON.

I'm not about to
lose to any kid!
FisherRalph1BeatenText:
Tch! I tried to
rush things…
FisherRalphAfterText:
Fishing is a life-
long passion.

#MON are life-
long friends!
FisherRalphSwarmText:
One, two, three…
Muahahaha, what a

great haul!
I'm done! Go ahead

and catch as many
as you can, kid!
Route32UnusedFisher1SeenText:
I keep catching
the same #MON…

Maybe a battle
will turn things around for me.
Route32UnusedFisher1BeatenText:
Nothing ever goes
right for me now…
Route32UnusedFisher1AfterText:
How come the guy
next to me catches good #MON?
Route32UnusedFisher2SeenText:
Heh, I'm on a roll
today. How about a battle, kid?
Route32UnusedFisher2BeatenText:
Oof. I wasn't
lucky that time.
Route32UnusedFisher2AfterText:
You have to have a
good ROD if you

want to catch good
#MON.
FisherHenryAfterText:
Freshly caught
#MON are no

match for properly
raised ones.
YoungsterAlbertSeenText:
I haven't seen you
around before.

So you think you
are pretty tough?
YoungsterAlbertAfterText:
I'm going to try
to be the best with my favorites.

I'm not using the
same tough #MON as everyone else.
YoungsterGordonSeenText:
I found some good
#MON in the grass!

I think they'll do
it for me!
YoungsterGordonBeatenText:
Darn. I thought I
could win.
YoungsterGordonAfterText:
The grass is full
of clingy things.
CamperRolandAfterText:
If you don't want
to battle, just avoid eye contact.
PicnickerLiz1SeenText:
Uh-huh. Yeah, and
you know…

Pardon? Battle?
I'm on the phone.

Oh, all right. But
make it fast.
PicnickerLiz1BeatenText:
Oh! I've got to
relieve my anger!
PicnickerLiz1AfterText:
I was having a
nice chat too.
BirdKeeperPeterSeenText:
That BADGE! It's
from VIOLET CITY!

You beat FALKNER?
BirdKeeperPeterBeatenText:
I know what my
weaknesses are.
BirdKeeperPeterAfterText:
I should train
again at the GYM in VIOLET CITY.
Route32UnusedText:
The fishermen
yelled at me for bugging them…
Text_RoarIntro:
WROOOOAR!
PEOPLE RUN WHEN I

ROAR! BUT YOU
CAME LOOKING!

THAT PLEASES ME!
NOW TAKE THIS!
Text_RoarOutro:
WROOOAR!
IT'S ROAR!

EVEN #MON RUN
FROM A GOOD ROAR!
MeetFriedaText:
FRIEDA: Yahoo!
It's Friday!

I'm FRIEDA of
Friday!

Nice to meet you!
FriedaGivesGiftText:
Here's a POISON
BARB for you!
FriedaGaveGiftText:
FRIEDA: Give it to
a #MON that has poison-type moves.

Oh!

It's wicked!

You'll be shocked
how good it makes poison moves!
FriedaFridayText:
FRIEDA: Hiya! What
day do you like?

I love Friday. No
doubt about it!

Don't you think
it's great too?
FriedaNotFridayText:
FRIEDA: Isn't it
Friday today?

It's so boring
when it's not!
